messages:
Zoe (Marketing): Heads-up team: planning to publish the release post + changelog tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Need final docs permalink, a short benchmark line, and webinar registration link by EOD today.

Hector (Eng): Roger. Suggest freezing canary at 8:30am PT to avoid overlap with publish. Small behavioral note on the batching API I'll add to the migration guide (non-breaking).

Priya (Product): No breaking changes for primary workflows. Visible win: routing improvements for small-batch chat -> p95 reduction. I can craft a one-line product blurb.

Maya (Docs): Draft changelog preview uploaded: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v6-preview. Will append the migration blurb once Hector posts the wording.

Omar (Release): Need a permalink by 6pm PT for our static-site pipeline. If deploy is green, target merging the blog at 9:25am PT so Marketing has a short QA window before 10am.

Nina (Events): Webinar booked for 11:00am PT tomorrow (30m). Looking for an Eng co-presenter for a short demo + Q&A segment. Hector, are you available for 11:00-11:12?

Hector (Eng): Yep, 11:00-11:12 works. I'll prepare a micro-benchmark slide and export a PNG for social assets.

Zoe (Marketing): Bench line check: can we claim "up to 35% lower p95 for short-chat workloads"?

Hector (Eng): 35% is the lab max for <40 tokens. I'd recommend conservative wording: "up to ~27%" across our test set.

Priya (Product): Agree with conservative phrasing. Proposed: "up to ~27% lower p95 latency on short-chat workloads (internal benchmark)."

Maya (Docs): Changelog snippet draft: 

``
## v6.0 — Routing + cache improvements (2026-07-08)
- Adaptive routing for short-session traffic
- KV prefix cache improvements to reduce redundant compute
- Bugfix: stable quantization fallback for mixed-precision paths
```

Zoe (Marketing): Good. Design needs the benchmark PNG by 5:00pm PT for socials—Hector, can you upload by 4:45pm? Caption: "internal benchmark — 95th percentile latency — short sessions".

Hector (Eng): Will upload to /drive/marketing/assets by 4:30pm PT. PNG caption will match.

assets-bot: asset_upload: /drive/marketing/assets/v6-bench.png by Hector  16:28 PT

Maya (Docs): Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712 — includes migration note and prelink.

Omar (Release): Deploy queued: docs-site job 19876 — ETA ~14m. I'll monitor and post permalink when live.

deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy: docs-site job 19876  ETA ~14m

Zoe (Marketing): Also tagging for webinar copy: Nina, please use this blurb: "Join a short demo of routing and cache updates, learn about cost/latency tradeoffs, and get your questions answered live."

Nina (Events): Got it. Registration page will be ready by 9:00am PT tomorrow. I'll post the link here when live.

Omar (Release): Deploy finished: docs-site job 19876 — SUCCESS. Changelog live at https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v6.0

Zoe (Marketing): Permalink received, adding to blog draft. Will queue merge at 9:25am PT for a 9:30am quick check and 10:00am publish.

Nina (Events): Webinar reg link live: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/2026-07-routing-cache — speaker list updated (Hector co-presenting).

Hector (Eng): If anyone wants the raw bench CSV, DM me. Happy to handle live Qs during the webinar channel.

Zoe (Marketing): Final checklist: docs permalink (done), changelog on site (done), blog + images queued (done), canary freeze 8:30am PT (Hector), webinar confirmed (Nina), PRs merged and pipeline green (Omar). :party_parrot:

Omar (Release): All green on my end. Good luck tomorrow!
